title: Animes
description: This pack will include alot of anime mods combined!
body:
# ✨ Animes In Minecraft ✨
### Bring Anime Powers Into Minecraft ⚡

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
> Become a sorcerer, shinobi, or pirate — and unlock legendary anime abilities in your Minecraft world.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 🧿 Featured Anime

### ⚔️ Jujutsu Kaisen
- Use **Cursed Energy**
- Unlock powerful cursed techniques
- Fight dangerous cursed spirits

### 🍥 Naruto
- Become a **Shinobi**
- Use abilities like **Rasengan** and **Sharingan**
- Master powerful ninja techniques

### 🏴‍☠️ One Piece
- Find and use **Devil Fruits**
- Gain unique supernatural powers
- Become the strongest pirate

### ✨ And More
- Anime weapons and armor  
- New enemies and abilities  
- Powerful combat mechanics  

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 🌍 Features

✔️ Anime powers in survival  
✔️ Multiplayer compatible  
✔️ High-quality anime mods  
✔️ Immersive combat and abilities  

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

# ⚡ Awaken Your Power ⚡
